providers._comment: Anthropic-protocol provider example (Kimi-for-Coding). sharedQuota=true: Kimi rate limits are account-level and shared across all models, so a quota 429 cools every model on the provider. maxOutputTokens: default max_tokens when the caller doesn't set one — Kimi meters TPM as prompt + REQUESTED max_tokens, so a lower default reduces TPM pressure (0/omitted = 8192).
providers.name: kimi

providers._comment: MiniMax Token Plan subscription, DIRECT (no gateway hop). Anthropic-compatible endpoint — MiniMax's recommended path, supports thinking blocks. auth="bearer": MiniMax authenticates subscription keys as Authorization: Bearer (Kimi's gateway, by contrast, requires x-api-key ONLY). MiniMax-M3's true window is 1M tokens — contextWindowTokens set with output headroom; per-provider contextWindowTokens enables intra-run tool-result compaction (null/omitted = no compaction). Adding a new provider is config-only when it speaks OpenAI chat-completions or Anthropic Messages; the quirk knobs are: api, auth, sharedQuota, maxOutputTokens, contextWindowTokens, modelsUrl.
providers.name: minimax

llm._overloadRetryNote: overloadRetryCount: in-place retries for transient 'engine overloaded' 429s (server-side capacity, not account quota) with exponential backoff + jitter before the model is cooled down. Default 3; 0 = every 429 cools immediately.
llm._triageRoleNote: Triage (failure-triage agent, phase 2) has its own AgentType — pin it to your CHEAPEST model here; per-task model escalation is phase 3. Per-project overrides land via PUT /api/agents/roles/triage/model.
llm._designArtistRoleNote: Designer + Artist use RoleAgentRegistry.ByAgentName() (built-in fall-back to CoreDev); they don't live in this Roles map. The Designer / Artist agents run in the Orchestrator process only and look up their provider via the same kilo-gateway as CoreDev.

projects._comment: DEPRECATED: the appsettings.json `projects[]` array is no longer the source of truth. Project registry lives in the SQLite `project` table. Add projects via the dashboard Projects page or POST /api/projects. This array is ignored at boot — kept here only as a discoverability hint for operators moving from a previous install.

headroom._comment: P4 Headroom — LLM cost optimization sidecar. See docs/headroom.md.
